about.label: about
paragraphs: I'm Ali Tunç, a system and network administrator based in Antwerp. My background is broad — from language teaching to hospitality — but my passion for technology brought me to where I am today.
I work with real production infrastructure: municipal networks, ESXi clusters, firewall migrations and monitoring from A to Z. No theory, just results.
I am currently studying for the Associate Degree in System and Network Administration at AP University of Applied Sciences Antwerp — alongside my hands-on experience at a Belgian municipality.
Multilingual in Dutch, English and Turkish — communication is never a problem.

cards.title: Zabbix Monitoring Infrastructure
cards.desc: Complete Zabbix 7.0 monitoring built from scratch — SNMP for UniFi switches, Konica Minolta printers and a Zyxel firewall, including auto-discovery, dashboards and Office 365 alerting.

cards.title: PacketFence NAC — EAP-TLS
cards.desc: PacketFence NAC lab with EAP-TLS authentication, a private PKI (Root CA + SubCA), Microsoft Intune SCEP integration and PowerShell Wi-Fi certificate automation for 106 schools.

cards.title: VLAN Redesign & Network Renewal
cards.desc: AS-IS documentation, vendor evaluation (Fortinet, Zyxel, Peplink, MikroTik), firewall matrix and a complete VLAN reorganisation for a Belgian municipality.

cards.title: OpenZiti ZTNA + Entra ID
cards.desc: Zero Trust Network Access via OpenZiti integrated with Microsoft Entra ID for OIDC authentication. JWT signer configuration and policy setup for secure remote access.
